gold_tier_at_execution: If independent adjudication incomplete: every metric labelled "against provisional, singly-adjudicated gold" and Threats states missing independent human arbitration. If human-adjudicated v2 exists, use v2 and re-run as sensitivity; any flipped REJECT changes C1 denominator and is reported per-issue.

inference.primary_ci: non-parametric issue-cluster bootstrap: resample issues with replacement (B>=10000), recompute the issue-equal-weighted statistic; percentile 95% CI
inference.sensitivity_ci_C1: exact Clopper-Pearson binomial CI for k/3 (reported because n=3)

multiplicity.rule: directional only, decision via CI lower bound > 0; no p-value confirmation; all other contrasts exploratory

parse_failures: unparseable verdict = not-ACCEPT (excluded from UA numerator); parse-failure rate reported separately

C1_unsupported_acceptance_gpt.aggregation_within_issue: UA indicator = 1 if model emits ACCEPT in >=1 sufficient condition (pre-register OR to avoid treating the 3 conditions as independent n); also report the per-condition breakdown as exploratory.
C1_unsupported_acceptance_gpt.denominator_issue_ids_sealed_note: 3 REJECT issues; ids live in frozen g3a_gold.jsonl, not restated here
C1_unsupported_acceptance_gpt.directional_reproduction_rule: point > 0 AND issue-cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0
C1_unsupported_acceptance_gpt.estimand: issue-equal-weighted UA rate over REJECT issues
C1_unsupported_acceptance_gpt.question: Does gpt-4.1-mini still ACCEPT gold-REJECT issues on sufficient-evidence surfaces?
